## 席位核对

**L1 first review: ACCEPT** · PR #34733 · card #34427 (ruling C, record 6942931911) · area o2-B · L1-a2 · 2026-11-17T09:27Z

Head-sha: `02e081472aac51ab6ed554504bdbf7d0ee25ad37`

Final-head comment 6944045060.

### Checklist

- **Shape.** Draft, base `main`, labels `documentation` and `skip-changeset`. The first line is `Part of #34427`, and the body has no closing keyword. That is right for ruling C: "No code change. Document … When that doc lands, this card closes `not_planned`". The close is a manual step after landing, so no closing verb belongs here. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are right for one docs paragraph.
- **Scope** (`get_files`): one path, `content/docs/ui/print-pages.mdx`, +9/−0. One commit, `02e08147`, on top of `main`, with no merge.
- **The paragraph against the measurement.** I read os-dev report 6931957598 on #34427 (Chromium print of the showcase invoice page shape, A4).
  - **21 lines.** Key on `[0|20|1]` = 3 sheets; key off `[3|18]` = 2 sheets. The paragraph's figure (3 with the key on, 2 with it off) matches.
  - **What happens with the key on.** The report shows a table that does not fit the rest of sheet 1 moving whole to sheet 2 and breaking there. Sheet 1 is left 27% blank with the key on, against 4% with it off. That matches "moves whole to the next sheet even when it cannot fit any single sheet, and is broken there" and "a blank lower part".
  - **"Can take one sheet more".** The report shows the extra sheet at 21–24 and 45 lines, and equal counts elsewhere, so "can" (not "does") is the right word.
- **The cross-reference.** The paragraph says column headings repeat on each sheet (`repeatTableHeaders`). The page's own table at `:74` says "on when omitted", and the key exists in `page.zod.ts`, so the sentence is true by default. No other sentence on the page contradicts the new paragraph. The sentence above it ("`avoidBreakInside` keeps each block whole on one sheet when it fits") still stands as written.
- **Ruling fidelity.** Ruling C asks only for this documentation. The PR adds no code, no spec change and no default change, and it says nothing that would recommend option A or B.
- **Gates.** 44 derived, 44 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. Five first exited because nothing was built, then exited 0 after a build.

### CI on this head

- `filter=latest` gives `success=30`, `skipped=25`, `failure=1`. The failure is `PR-body guards` run 133932194024 (09:03:51Z). It failed on a body sentence that put a closing word next to the card number. The body was then corrected, and run 133932542215 of the same check on this head is `success` (09:04:32Z–09:05:08Z), later than the failure. The body at this head has no closing keyword. That is the only red, and it is superseded.
- ⚠️ `filter=latest` still lists the failed run beside the success, because the two runs are in separate check suites. Before queueing, confirm the PR's own checks view shows the guard green. If it does not, re-run that one job. Do not push.

### L2 and landing

- **L2: not owed.** Docs only: nothing under `packages/spec/src/**`, `Clause-②: no`, no narrowing, no governed rule text.
- **Landing tier** (`node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 34733`): `NOT governed — ordinary queue landing`, 9 changed lines ≤ 3000. This is not spec surface. The area lands it. After landing, close #34427 as `not_planned` by hand, as the ruling says, and remove `pm:dispatched`.
